LONG-STAY five tests: (1) nightly rate posted - yes ($29-43 'Short-Term Camping' listed first); (2) online booking engine - yes (Campspot, nightly); (3) operator leads with daily camping, monthly ('starting at $525 + Metered Electric') and seasonal ('$1,100 + Metered Electric', Apr 1-Nov 1) offered below it; (4) nightly share - the 2026-10-13 Campspot read showed 53 RV sites free for one Tuesday night in October across 8 RV types, out of 80 numbered sites: well over 1 in 10; (5) no homes or lots for sale. Passes; not mostly seasonal.

WATERFRONT (stored pond, not --AWH): KEEP pond. The main water is a pond by size: ~1.8 acres counted on Esri imagery plus a narrow west arm, so ~2-2.5 acres (<5); the south pond ~1.5 acres. The operator map places sites 60-66 on the inner side of the north road with only lawn between them and the main pond's north-west bank; Esri/NAIP show a gravel strip with pads there ~10-20 m from the water over grass (the pads themselves are partly under canopy, so the site-by-site placement rests on the operator map). Sites 1-9 and 50-59 have a road between them and the water (not on-water). Whether 60-66 are nightly or seasonal sites was not read (Campspot site list not opened this pass; see unread). Campspot's own RV types carry a 'Waterfront Site' amenity (2026-10-13 read).
